description: Genuine (non-scam) messages for the scam checker's blind test set: real messages team members actually received, with personal details replaced. Copy the example entry once per message. See README_scam_check_blind_set.md.
target: about 15 messages, mixing banks, delivery, utilities, telecom, government and personal messages, in English and Hinglish
replace_before_adding: phone numbers -> [PHONE] (keep a short code like 1909 or a sender ID like AD-HDFCBK as it is: those are part of what the checker sees)
account, card, policy, order and tracking numbers -> keep only the last 4 digits, e.g. XXXX1234
links -> keep the domain (e.g. hdfcbank.com), replace anything after it that identifies you with /[path]

cases.label: genuine
cases.sender: AD-XXXXXX (the sender ID as shown on your phone)
cases.message: Paste the message here, with personal details replaced as listed above.
